# Method GetMaterialDepthMaxi

#### GetMaterialDepthMaxi(ElementId)

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 11, 300, 160)]

```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- |
